termsSections.title: Account and use of the service
termsSections.body: ThaiShopFun helps you discover and buy from shops. You must provide accurate, up-to-date information, keep your password secure, and notify support if your account is used without permission. If you cannot enter into contracts on your own, you need consent from a lawful representative before using the service.

termsSections.title: Products, pricing, and orders
termsSections.body: Review product details, options, quantity, price, shipping, and address before confirming an order. Discounts and stock depend on each listing. If information is wrong or items cannot be supplied, we or the shop will notify you so you can choose a remedy or cancel as applicable, without extra charges unless you confirm them.

termsSections.title: Payment and delivery
termsSections.body: Pay only through channels shown in the system. Delivery times are estimates and may change by area, carrier, or force majeure. Check order status and contact support if you have issues.

termsSections.title: Cancellations, returns, and refunds
termsSections.body: Check conditions on product and order pages before paying. If you receive the wrong item, damage, or a mismatch, contact support with your order number and evidence. Refund timing depends on the case and payment method. Shop terms cannot remove consumer rights protected by law.

termsSections.title: Acceptable use
termsSections.body: Do not use accounts for fraud, impersonation, infringing others' rights, illegal content, or disrupting the system. Reviews should reflect real experience. We may restrict misuse when necessary, with a way to explain, without affecting lawful order or refund rights.

termsSections.title: Content rights and liability
termsSections.body: Trademarks, images, and platform content belong to their rights holders. Use them only with proper permission. Sellers are responsible for their product details and quality. ThaiShopFun is responsible for platform services as required by law. These terms do not exclude liability where law forbids it.

termsSections.title: Changes and contact
termsSections.body: Material changes will be announced through the service before they apply when appropriate. Changes will not reduce rights from existing orders. Questions or disputes: contact ThaiShopFun via the help page. These terms are governed by Thai law without limiting complaints to competent authorities.

privacySections.title: Data we use to provide the service
privacySections.body: Account data includes name, email, phone, and identity verification details. When you shop, we may process shipping addresses, orders, payment status, support contacts, and technical data needed for security.

privacySections.title: Purposes and legal bases
privacySections.body: We use data to create and manage accounts, fulfill orders, deliver goods, coordinate payments and refunds, and answer your requests, plus legal compliance and fraud prevention on legitimate interests while respecting your rights. Without required data, you may not register or place orders.

privacySections.title: Who may receive data
privacySections.body: We share only what is needed with shops you order from, carriers, payment providers, and related system providers under purpose and confidentiality requirements, and authorities when legally required. Cross-border transfers follow legal safeguards.

privacySections.title: Retention and security
privacySections.body: We keep data as needed for accounts and transactions, including periods required for accounting, tax, disputes, or law. When no longer needed, we delete, destroy, or anonymize it, with access limited by role and appropriate security measures.

privacySections.title: Your rights
privacySections.body: You may request access, copies, correction, deletion, restriction, objection, or portability as allowed by law. If processing relies on consent, you may withdraw it without affecting lawful processing before withdrawal, and you may complain to the Personal Data Protection Committee.

privacySections.title: Cookies and marketing
privacySections.body: We use cookies or similar tech needed for login and security. Marketing or analytics that need consent are requested separately. Creating an account is not consent to ads or non-essential uses.

privacySections.title: Contact and policy updates
privacySections.body: To exercise rights or ask about personal data, contact ThaiShopFun support via the help page with the subject “Personal data.” We may verify identity before acting. Material changes will be announced through the service.
